paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between Prompt Length and Accuracy for two categories, identified in the legend as mmsd and mmsd2. The x-axis is labeled "Prompt Length" and features a linear scale ranging from 2 to 16, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 77 to 81 at regular intervals of 1. The "mmsd" category is represented by a solid red-orange line with circular markers. It begins at its highest accuracy value of approximately 81.05 at a prompt length of 2, declines to approximately 80.4 at a length of 4, rises to a local peak of approximately 80.8 at a length of 8, and gradually declines to end at approximately 80.6 at a length of 16. The "mmsd2" category is depicted by a solid yellow line with circular markers. This line starts at an accuracy of approximately 77.5 at a prompt length of 2, drops to a local minimum of approximately 76.5 at a length of 4, increases to a local peak of approximately 77.3 at a length of 8, and then steadily declines to end at its lowest value of approximately 76.3 at a length of 16.
